terminals.name: web
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1; export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; export NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL="${NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL:-https://placeholder.convex.cloud}"; bun dev:web

terminals.name: cli
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1; export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; bun dev:cli
